reference_answer: Yes. A UAE account with no transaction made by you for 12 months becomes dormant and is charged AED 10 per month, taken only from the balance. Make any transaction, such as a small top-up, to reactivate it.

query: I'm an expat in Riyadh with an Iqama. Can I verify my account with my passport instead?
reference_answer: No. A passport can't verify a Saudi account; residents use their Iqama, plus a selfie taken in the app.

query: غيرت رقمي والرقم القديم ما عاد عندي، كيف أدخل حسابي؟
reference_answer: On the login screen tap Forgot password > I no longer have this number, then scan your ID and take a selfie.

query: I'm moving from Dubai to Riyadh for a new job. Can I just switch my Sahla account over to Saudi?
reference_answer: No. Each account belongs to one country, and the country of an existing account can't be changed.

query: كم عدد الحسابات البنكية التي يمكنني ربطها بحسابي في التطبيق؟
reference_answer: You can link up to 3 bank accounts, each in your own name and in the same country as your Sahla Pay account.

query: My transfer failed and it says 'Recipient can't receive this amount'. What does that mean?
reference_answer: The recipient's account would go over its balance limit, usually because it isn't verified. Ask them to verify or send a smaller amount.

query: هل توجد رسوم على دفع الفواتير من رصيد المحفظة في مصر؟
reference_answer: Yes. In Egypt each bill payment costs EGP 2 plus VAT; some billers add their own convenience charge.

query: كم الـ fee لو سويت top up بالـ debit card في الإمارات؟
reference_answer: Debit card top-ups in the UAE cost 1.5% plus VAT; bank transfer top-ups are free.

query: رابط الدفع اللي أرسلته للزبون، متى ينتهي؟
reference_answer: Payment links expire after 30 calendar days.

query: Hotel charged me twice, one says pending and the other completed. Did I really pay double?
reference_answer: Probably not: the pending one is usually a hold, and it drops off on its own within 7 calendar days. If both say Completed, contact the merchant.

query: رجعت قطعة من الـ order والـ refund وصلني أقل من اللي توقعته، ليش؟
reference_answer: Check with the merchant: they may have kept a delivery or restocking fee, refunded only some items, or the exchange rate changed for a foreign-currency payment.

query: I paid with my old card and it's since been replaced. Will the shop's refund still reach me?
reference_answer: Yes. Refunds follow your account, not the card, so a refund to the old card number lands in your balance.

query: حولت حوالة دولية من السعودية لشخص غلط، تقدرون ترجعونها؟
reference_answer: Sahla Pay can ask the receiving bank to return it (a recall), but the bank decides, and getting money back after it's sent is harder than for local transfers.

query: إذا أعاد بنك المستفيد التحويل، فهل تُسترد رسوم التحويل أيضاً؟
reference_answer: Yes. If a transfer fails or is returned by the recipient's bank, the transfer fee is refunded too.

query: How much do you charge to recall an international transfer from the UAE, and do I get it back if it fails?
reference_answer: A recall costs AED 50 in the UAE. It's charged when you ask and isn't refunded even if the recall fails.

query: How long do I have to approve an online payment in the app before it gets cancelled?
reference_answer: You have 5 minutes to approve a 3-D Secure request in the app; after that the payment is cancelled.

query: My new card arrived but there was no PIN in the envelope. Where do I get it?
reference_answer: PINs aren't sent by post: you set it in the app when you activate the card. If you skipped that step, see the temporary PIN under Cards > Card settings > Show PIN.

query: لو بتزيدون الرسوم، كم مدة تبلغونا قبلها؟
reference_answer: At least 30 calendar days before a fee goes up or a new fee starts, by email and in the app; you can close your account for free before then.

query: وصلتني رسالة تقول إن طردي بانتظار دفع رسوم توصيل عبر رابط. هل هي رسالة احتيال؟
reference_answer: Very likely. A parcel-fee request with a payment link is a common scam trick; don't tap the link or pay.

query: أحد دخل حسابي وغير الإيميل، وش أسوي بسرعة؟
reference_answer: Change your password, remove unknown devices in Profile > Security > Trusted devices, freeze your card, and check your email and phone under Personal details.

query: الموبايل اتسرق مني، أعمل ايه الأول عشان أحمي حسابي؟
reference_answer: Block your SIM with your operator, call the fraud line from another phone so they block the device and freeze your card, and remove the stolen phone from Trusted devices if you can.

query: el notifications mesh btewsalni 3al android, a3mel eh?
reference_answer: In Android Settings > Apps > Sahla Pay > Notifications allow them and make sure battery saving isn't stopping the app, then check Profile > Notifications in the app.

query: كيف أغيّر لغة التطبيق إلى العربية؟
reference_answer: Go to Profile > Settings > Language and choose العربية; the app restarts in Arabic with a right-to-left layout.

query: أبوي كفيف، يقدر يستخدم التطبيق مع قارئ الشاشة؟
reference_answer: Yes. The app works with VoiceOver on iPhone and TalkBack on Android, in Arabic and English.

query: لو مسحت الأبلكيشن من الموبايل، الحساب بيتقفل؟
reference_answer: No. Deleting the app only removes it from your phone; your account, balance and card stay active.

query: How do I make a formal complaint about how support handled my case?
reference_answer: Go to Help > Make a complaint, explain what happened and what you want, attach any evidence and submit; complaints go to a separate team.

query: بعد إغلاق حسابي في السعودية، كم سنة تحتفظون ببياناتي؟
reference_answer: For Saudi accounts, records are kept for 10 years after closure, as the law requires.

query: أبي أرسل عيدية لأكثر من شخص مرة وحدة، كيف أسويها من الـ app؟
reference_answer: Tap Send > To a Sahla Pay user and add more recipients to send to several people at once; transfers to Sahla Pay users are free and instant, even on Eid.

query: Which days count as business days for transfers in the UAE?
reference_answer: In the UAE business days are Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays.

query: هل أحصل على بطاقة افتراضية تلقائياً إذا كان حسابي في مصر؟
reference_answer: No. In Egypt you request it with Cards > Get a virtual card, because it has a one-time fee; in Saudi Arabia and the UAE it's created automatically.

query: كم تكلفة البطاقة البلاستيكية في مصر؟
reference_answer: A physical card costs EGP 150 in Egypt, charged once when you order it.

query: I'm visiting Dubai on a tourist visa for a month. Can I open a Sahla Pay account?
reference_answer: No. Visitors on a tourist or visit visa can't open a personal Sahla Pay account.

query: رفعت أوراق التوثيق يوم الخميس بالليل وأنا في الرياض، متى بيراجعونها؟
reference_answer: Business days in Saudi Arabia are Sunday to Thursday, so a review submitted on Thursday evening is generally handled from Sunday; manual reviews take up to 1 business day.

query: The English spelling of my name in the app is a bit different from my ID. Will that hold up my verification?
reference_answer: Minor differences between Arabic and English spellings are acceptable; a different family name may need further review.

query: As a guardian, can I move money out of my 17-year-old's Sahla account in Egypt?
reference_answer: No. The guardian can set a lower limit, review transactions and freeze the card, but can't transfer funds out of the minor's account.

query: Does the money I keep in Pockets count toward my balance limit?
reference_answer: Yes. The balance limit covers all money in your account, including funds in Pockets.

query: إذا اعترضت على تحويل، هل يعود مبلغه إلى حدي اليومي فوراً؟
reference_answer: No. A disputed transfer stays counted until the dispute is resolved; only failed or cancelled transfers return to your allowance immediately.

query: كم الحد الشهري للتحويل لحساب موثق في الإمارات؟
reference_answer: A verified UAE account can transfer up to AED 75,000 per month.

reference_answer: No. The minimum fee is charged on every transfer, so splitting one large transfer into smaller ones can cost more overall.

query: حولت لـ bank account غلط بالغلط، نفس طريقة الـ dispute؟
reference_answer: Yes, it uses the same dispute process, but the return is requested through the receiving bank, which makes the final decision, so it usually takes longer.

query: Is there a maximum amount for a single InstaPay transfer?
reference_answer: Yes. Each InstaPay transfer is limited to EGP 50,000, and it also uses part of your daily transfer allowance.

query: ينفع حد يبعتلي فلوس على سهلة باي عن طريق انستاباي؟
reference_answer: Not to a Sahla Pay InstaPay address. Give the sender your Sahla Pay IBAN, and they can use InstaPay to make a normal bank transfer to it.

query: كم رسوم التحويل عبر إنستاباي؟
reference_answer: The same as other local bank transfers in Egypt: 0.5% of the amount, minimum EGP 5 and maximum EGP 20.

query: لو وافقتوا على رفع الحد المؤقت، الحد الشهري بيزيد بعد؟
reference_answer: No. A temporary increase changes only the daily transfer limit; the monthly limit and maximum balance stay the same.

query: كام مرة في السنة أقدر أطلب رفع مؤقت للحد وأنا في السعودية؟
reference_answer: No more than 2 times in a calendar year.

query: كم تستغرق مراجعة طلب رفع الحد المؤقت في الإمارات؟
reference_answer: Requests are reviewed within 1 business day, and an approved limit takes effect immediately.

query: I only noticed an unauthorized card payment a week later. Am I still covered in the UAE?
reference_answer: Reports made after 2 calendar days are subject to a maximum customer loss of AED 500, unless you acted fraudulently or with gross negligence.

query: إذا أعطيت رمز التحقق لشخص اتصل بي، فهل أفقد حقي في استرداد المبلغ؟
reference_answer: Telling a caller your one-time password counts as gross negligence, and the protection for unauthorized transactions, including the maximum-loss limit, doesn't apply in that case.

query: الـ card حقي بينتهي قريب، الـ renewal بفلوس؟
reference_answer: No. Renewing an expiring card is free in all three countries.

query: هل تتوفر خدمة أبل باي لحسابات مصر؟
reference_answer: Not yet. Apple Pay is available in Saudi Arabia and the UAE but not yet in Egypt.

query: صحيح أول سحبتين في الشهر مجانية بالسعودية؟
reference_answer: Yes. In Saudi Arabia the first 2 withdrawals each calendar month at Saudi ATMs are free; after that it's SAR 3 plus VAT, and withdrawals abroad are always charged.

query: المندوب جا مرتين وما لقاني، وين صار الكرت؟
reference_answer: After two unsuccessful delivery attempts the courier returns the card. When the status shows Returned, select Arrange delivery to pick a new date or address.

query: Getting error E315 when I try to send money to my sister. What's that?
reference_answer: E315 means the payment would put the recipient over their balance limit; she can verify her account, or you can send a smaller amount.

query: طلع لي error E600 وأنا أحول، وش معناه؟
reference_answer: E600 means verification is required; complete it through Profile.

query: غيرت الموبايل، الكارت هيظهر في جوجل باي لوحده؟
reference_answer: No. Cards don't move between phones in mobile wallets; add your Sahla Pay card again on the new phone.

query: كم كانت مدة استرداد مبالغ التجار لحسابات الإمارات خلال عام 2025؟
reference_answer: During 2025, merchant refunds to UAE accounts took up to 14 business days. (It's 10 business days now.)

query: كم الحد اليومي للتحويل؟
reference_answer: For verified accounts: SAR 20,000 in Saudi Arabia, AED 15,000 in the UAE or EGP 60,000 in Egypt; lower for unverified accounts.

query: How long does a merchant refund take to show up in my balance?
reference_answer: After the merchant sends it: up to 7 business days in Saudi Arabia, 10 in the UAE or 14 in Egypt.

query: كم تستغرق المراجعة اليدوية للتحقق من الهوية؟
reference_answer: Up to 1 business day in Saudi Arabia, 2 in the UAE or 3 in Egypt.

query: كم أقدر أدفع بالكرت تاب بدون الرقم السري؟
reference_answer: Up to SAR 300 in Saudi Arabia, AED 500 in the UAE or EGP 600 in Egypt per payment.

query: Is there a fee if I don't use my account for a long time?
reference_answer: No fee in Saudi Arabia; after 12 months without activity AED 10 a month in the UAE; after 18 months EGP 20 a month in Egypt.

query: ينفع أضيف الكارت على ابل باي؟
reference_answer: Yes in Saudi Arabia and the UAE (Cards > Add to Apple Wallet); not yet available in Egypt.

query: ما الحد الأقصى للرصيد في المحفظة بعد توثيق الحساب؟
reference_answer: SAR 100,000 in Saudi Arabia, AED 75,000 in the UAE or EGP 300,000 in Egypt.

query: How long do you keep my data after I close my account?
reference_answer: 10 years in Saudi Arabia, 5 years in the UAE and 5 years in Egypt.

query: How much is the international transfer fee?
reference_answer: 1.5% (minimum SAR 15) from Saudi Arabia or 1.25% (minimum AED 15) from the UAE, plus VAT; not available from Egypt.

query: كم أقصى مبلغ أدفعه بالباركود في العملية الوحدة؟
reference_answer: SAR 5,000 in Saudi Arabia, AED 5,000 in the UAE or EGP 10,000 in Egypt per QR payment.

query: How much is the seller fee when someone pays my payment link?
reference_answer: 1% in Saudi Arabia, 1% in the UAE and 1.5% in Egypt, taken from the payment.

query: رسوم دفع الفواتير كام؟
reference_answer: Free in Saudi Arabia and the UAE; EGP 2 plus VAT per bill in Egypt.

query: كم الـ maximum balance للحساب الـ unverified؟
reference_answer: SAR 5,000 in Saudi Arabia, AED 3,000 in the UAE or EGP 20,000 in Egypt.
